statement: The minimum real tritangent-plane count for a regular real canonical genus-four sextic is zero.

source.location: Table 1, printed p.8, row with no real connected components

notes:
Counts planes defined over R, not only those with three real contacts. The zero row establishes attainability.

The underlying real odd-theta count is Gross–Harris, Proposition 5.1. Hauenstein et al. explicitly attribute their Table 1 to this theory; their new certification method is not the origin of the spectrum recorded here.
